title: Two Sum
prompt:
Write `TwoSum(nums []int, target int) []int` that returns indices `[i, j]`, `i < j`, with `nums[i] + nums[j] == target`, in O(n). An element can't pair with itself. Return `nil` if there is no pair.

`[2 7 11 15]`, `9` → `[0 1]`
hint: Map each value to its index, and look up `target - v` before storing `v`.
